judgeVerdict:
FABLE-JUDGE VERDICT on the KAIF 2.4 → 2.5 update (KAGO, 2026-09-04): VERIFIED WITH CAVEATS.

Claims re-run, not trusted:
1. "Versions stamped" — `node -e` read of `.kaif/kaif.json`: version=2.5, released=2026-09-04, history
   carries 2.2→2.3, 2.3→2.4 (core-update) and 2.4→2.5 (route `bootstrap`, 2026-09-04T17:11:13+03:00);
   `node .kaif/kaif-core.mjs version` → `KAIF 2.5 (released 2026-09-04) · tracking: origin · lang: ru`. CONFIRMED.
2. "Nothing owner-authored lost" — `git status --short` over STATUS.md, GOAL.md, PROJECT_HISTORY.md,
   EXPERIENCE.md, plans/, bugs/, ideas/, interviews/, researches/, curves/, homeworks/, profiles/, workloads/,
   tools/, automation-engine/: two lines only, both deliberate additions of this pass — MASTER_PLAN.md
   (+7/−0, the delivery-metric block the 2.5 template convention asks for) and plans/54 (+1 comment line,
   a KAIF-VERSION-OK marker). `npm run check` → «молитва: 12 канон-документов, все копии совпадают с
   PHILOSOPHY.md». CONFIRMED.
3. "The merges are real" — anchored pairs KAIF:PRAYER 1/1 in all 8 carriers (AGENT_GUIDE, PHILOSOPHY,
   BUG_FIXING, TESTING, REQUIREMENTS, STATUS, GOAL, MASTER_PLAN); the mechanically merged modules each
   found exactly once by grep (fourth door in PHILOSOPHY = 1, severity ladder in BUG_FIXING = 1 at line 109
   AFTER the prayer END at line 37, scenario form in REQUIREMENTS = 1, size budgets + FORK paragraph in
   AGENT_GUIDE = 1); the hand folds each once (INTENT/AUTH/TWINS/PENDING/FORK in step 7 = 1, the @guard
   template block in TESTING = 1, DELIVERY: in AGENT_GUIDE = 3 lines — the fable-loop paragraph and rule 1);
   `cmp` of the four edited skills against .agents/.grok/.cline = 12/12 identical; `check` → 0 drifted
   mirrors. CONFIRMED.
4. "The project still works" — `npm run check`: 79 .mjs parse, 1699 text files encoding-clean, threat
   guard 0 new violations / 1 pre-existing debt, entry guard 34/0/0. `npm run selftest:all`: ИТОГ наборов 48,
   красных 0, зелёных блоков 2501, 48.3 с — identical to the numbers STATUS.md recorded before the update
   (48/0/2501). `node .kaif/kaif-core.mjs check`: manifest satisfied, 89 files + 152 agent artifacts. CONFIRMED.
5. "Replaced content carries no owner edits" — the tree was clean at 3a00d75 before the pass; `cmp` of
   `.kaif/backup-2.4-2.5/<f>` against `git show HEAD:<f>` for every replaced/merged path present in the
   backup: compared 29, mismatches 0. CONFIRMED.
6. "The rehearsal bound the live pass" — the sandbox-b copy (git archive → git init → thin KAIF.md +
   loader) produced a KAIF_UPDATE_TASK.md byte-IDENTICAL to the live one (`diff` empty), the same counters
   (18 replaced · 12 modules · 4 added · 63 kept) and the same wholesale verdicts with numbers
   (AGENT_GUIDE baseFound 28 of 29 ceiling 4 → merged; the other four N of N → merged). CONFIRMED.
7. Fork-without-recon hunt — the route choice (core-update with the deployed 2.4 core vs bootstrap with the
   fresh 2.5 core) carried its FORK: line in the chat before the live run: options A | B · price of error
   low (backup tree + git) · consulted: the /kaif-update route note + two sandbox rehearsals (route A observed
   planting the severity ladder INSIDE the localized prayer pair; route B observed placing it after the END).
   PASSES.
8. Delivery-line hunt — `DELIVERY: краёв 11/389 → 11/389 · режимов 1/4 → 1/4; moved by: nothing (a
   framework update, offline by the owner's order) | blocker: edge runs happen only with the owner at the
   machine (интервью 017, Q4)`; `npm run curve -- --progress` → «краёв 11/389 (прожигом 9 · соседкой 1 ·
   выведено 0) · режимов отгружено 1/4». Zero delta with a named blocker. PASSES.
Weakened tests: none — no test or guard was touched; the TESTING 6a text was collapsed to the owner's quote
plus a pointer (the 2.5 "mechanized lesson collapses" rule), its full text stays in git history.

Caveats:
- Eight policy changes of 2.5 are adopted on the owner's update order and surfaced in the chat with the veto
  open: the AUTH carve-out (already local law since 2026-08-30), FORK:, gate 5 second half, the guarded-loop
  boundary, the S1/S2/S3 ladder + DELIVERY: line, `kaif-core report`, the team defaults, the four update
  behaviours. The prayer cadence stays the owner's own setting (интервью 017 Q2 = B) — legal under 2.5.
- The two new team-deployment references arrive in English and stay English (agent-read).
- `kaif-core report` refuses three pre-2.5 local tickets (bugs/KAIF/10, 11, 12: lowercase «not yet») and
  one delivered-by-hand ticket (16: prose, no URL on the contract line) with the same «neither NOT YET nor a
  URL» message — ticketed this pass (bugs/KAIF/17); 10–12 are fixed in 2.5 (10 observed here, 11–12 by the
  release notes) and their DONE closure is a named follow-up, not part of this update.
- Line budgets warn on five re-read documents (STATUS 1809/200, GOAL 1958/300, AGENT_GUIDE 1655/1200,
  MASTER_PLAN 466/300, REQUIREMENTS 251/250) — pre-existing bonsai debt, advisory by design.
- The permission-layer allowlist for `node .kaif/kaif-core.mjs report` was NOT added — the owner's config.
